summary_en: Ibrahim prays over the finished House — for safety, against idols, and for a messenger from among his descendants.

paragraphs.ar: وَلَمَّا انْتَهَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ مِنْ بِنَاءِ الْبَيْتِ، دَعَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ رَبَّهُ.
paragraphs.en: When Ibrahim and Isma'il, peace be upon them, had finished building the House, Ibrahim prayed to his Lord.

paragraphs.ar: دَعَا أَنْ يَكُونَ هَذَا الْبَلَدُ آمِنًا، وَأَنْ يُبْعِدَهُ اللَّهُ وَأَوْلَادَهُ عَنْ عِبَادَةِ الْأَصْنَامِ.
paragraphs.en: He prayed that this land would be safe, and that Allah would keep him and his children far from worshipping idols.
paragraphs.note: Sets up episode 5, where the idols come anyway.

paragraphs.en: "My Lord, make this land secure, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols."
paragraphs.ar: ﴿وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَ ٰ⁠هِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنࣰا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ﴾

audio.source: Recorded by Shaykh AbdulAziz Salar Rasoul; used with permission

paragraphs.ar: وَدَعَا أَنْ يُعَلِّمَهُمُ اللَّهُ كَيْفَ يَعْبُدُونَهُ.
paragraphs.en: He prayed that Allah would teach them how to worship Him.
"Our Lord, make us submit to You, and from our descendants a nation submitting to You. Show us our rites of worship, and turn to us in mercy. You are the Ever-Relenting, the Most Merciful."
paragraphs.ar: ﴿رَبَّنَا وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَيۡنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَاۤ أُمَّةࣰ مُّسۡلِمَةࣰ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبۡ عَلَيۡنَاۤۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

audio.source: Recorded by Shaykh AbdulAziz Salar Rasoul; used with permission

paragraphs.ar: وَدَعَا دُعَاءً آخَرَ، لِأَوْلَادِ أَوْلَادِهِ الَّذِينَ سَيَأْتُونَ بَعْدَ زَمَنٍ طَوِيلٍ. دَعَا أَنْ يُرْسِلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ.
paragraphs.en: And he made another prayer, for his descendants who would come long after. He prayed that Allah would send among them a messenger from among themselves.
"Our Lord, raise up among them a messenger from among themselves, who will recite Your verses to them, teach them the Book and wisdom, and purify them. You are the Almighty, the All-Wise."
paragraphs.note: The hinge of the whole series. Answered in paragraph 13, and again in volume 4.
paragraphs.ar: ﴿رَبَّنَا وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِيهِمۡ رَسُولࣰا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُوا۟ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَـٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ﴾

audio.source: Recorded by Shaykh AbdulAziz Salar Rasoul; used with permission

paragraphs.ar: وَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنْ يُنَادِيَ النَّاسَ إِلَى الْحَجِّ.
paragraphs.en: And Allah commanded Ibrahim to call the people to the pilgrimage.
"And proclaim the pilgrimage among the people: they will come to you on foot, and on every lean camel, coming from every distant pass."
paragraphs.ar: ﴿وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَجِّ يَأۡتُوكَ رِجَالࣰا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرࣲ يَأۡتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقࣲ﴾

audio.source: Recorded by Shaykh AbdulAziz Salar Rasoul; used with permission

paragraphs.ar: فَصَارَ النَّاسُ يَأْتُونَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ.
paragraphs.en: And people began coming to the House from every place.
refs: Ibn Hisham — remnants of the religion of Ibrahim
paragraphs.note: Ibn Hisham lists the hajj, the tawaf and the standing at Arafa among what survived from Ibrahim's time.

paragraphs.ar: وَمَرَّتِ السِّنُونَ، وَمَرَّتْ أَجْيَالٌ بَعْدَ أَجْيَالٍ. وَلَمْ يَأْتِ ذَلِكَ الرَّسُولُ.
paragraphs.en: The years passed, generation after generation, and that messenger did not come.

paragraphs.ar: لَكِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَنْسَ دُعَاءَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ.
paragraphs.en: But Allah had not forgotten Ibrahim's prayer.
paragraphs.note: Editor's line. It draws on the hadith in the next card, where the Prophet ﷺ names the prayer of Ibrahim as the beginning of his matter.

paragraphs.ar: وَبَعْدَ زَمَنٍ طَوِيلٍ جِدًّا، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَخَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَإِنَّ آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لَمُنْجَدِلٌ فِي طِينَتِهِ، وَسَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَوَّلِ ذَلِكَ: دَعْوَةُ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبِشَارَةُ عِيسَى بِي، وَرُؤْيَا أُمِّي الَّتِي رَأَتْ.»
paragraphs.en: Long, long afterwards, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I was Allah's servant and the Seal of the Prophets while Adam, peace be upon him, still lay in his clay. And I will tell you the beginning of it: the prayer of my father Ibrahim, the good news 'Isa gave of me, and the vision my mother saw."
refs: Musnad Ahmad 17150 (al-Risala numbering) — al-Irbad ibn Sariya

quote.text: إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَخَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ وَإِنَّ آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام لَمُنْجَدِلٌ فِي طِينَتِهِ وَسَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَوَّلِ ذَلِكَ دَعْوَةُ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبِشَارَةُ عِيسَى بِي وَرُؤْيَا أُمِّي الَّتِي رَأَتْ

paragraphs.note: Exact words, a continuous excerpt (the hadith goes on: وكذلك أمهات النبيين ترين). Graded hasan in the takhrij consulted; authenticated by Ibn Hibban (6404) and al-Hakim (2/600). Some sources read إني عند الله for إني عبد الله. Gloss: خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ = the last of the prophets; لَمُنْجَدِلٌ فِي طِينَتِهِ = still lying as clay, not yet created; دَعْوَةُ = prayer; بِشَارَةُ = good news; رُؤْيَا = vision.

paragraphs.ar: كَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّسُولُ هُوَ الْجَوَابَ. وَلَكِنْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ، كَانَ الْوَادِي سَيَنْسَى.
paragraphs.en: That messenger was the answer. But before he came, the valley would forget.
